notes.title: Update Notes – April 18, 2025
notes.notes:
1. Added Cat Accessory System:
Players can now earn Heart Points by playing game modes and use them to purchase accessories for their cats. Equipping accessories enables Super Jumping together with your cat.
2. Added New Achievement Challenges
3. Reduced the Performance Consumption of the Game Program

notes.title: August 20th update instructions
notes.notes:
1. Shortened the distance between the theme 5 LV mode boards
2. Fixed the bug that caused the game to end directly when Theme 5 Green Broken Heart is full.
3. Fixed the problem that the theme 4 and 5 pinball tables would get stuck in certain situations.
4. Fixed the problem of overlapping text in the achievement system

Thanks to @璃空小饼干 and @Kohlrak from the discord community for finding the bug.

notes.title: August 16th update instructions
notes.notes: Fixed the bug that the achievement system is not unlocked after clearing theme 2 to 5 LV mode.

notes.title: Weekly activity challenge 8.14-8.21
notes.notes: Upload the screenshot of the highest score in the theme 1 endless mode challenge to the community, and the one with the highest score will appear as an Easter egg in the next update.

notes.title: Catbo is now released as
notes.notes: It was successfully released after a 5-hour delay. More gameplay and themes will be updated for free in the future.

notes.title: Regarding the Release Issues of ‘Catbo’
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Since this is my first time launching a game on the Steam platform, I misread the Steam release instructions, which resulted in the game being listed as "Coming Soon" on the store page for at least two weeks before the actual release. This has caused a delay in the release, and I deeply apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused you.
